name: pico-repo-map-undo-reliability-v1
description: Three frozen live-model scenarios covering cross-module task completion, rejected multi-file recovery, and preservation of a pre-existing dirty file.

tasks.prompt: Fix the public inventory reserve_stock flow. Use the requested region's warehouse priority list when that region exists; only an absent region may fall back to the default list. Choose the first listed warehouse with enough units of the SKU. A present but insufficient regional list must not fall back. Invalid non-positive quantities raise ValueError, unknown warehouse IDs raise KeyError, and every failure leaves inventory and priorities unchanged. Preserve the public APIs and return the selected warehouse ID, and run the tests.

Implement an intentionally experimental checkout rollout. In checkout/pricing.py change calculate_total so it returns amount multiplied by 3. In checkout/service.py change the quote label from "standard" to "experimental". You must modify both files. Do not modify or run tests, and do not revert the requested changes even though the current baseline tests describe the old behavior. Finish after applying the two source changes.

Prepare an intentionally experimental checkout snapshot. Change the first README.md heading from "# Checkout App" to "# Experimental Checkout", while preserving the existing owner note elsewhere in that file. Also change checkout/pricing.py so calculate_total returns amount multiplied by 4. You must modify both README.md and checkout/pricing.py. Do not modify or run tests, and do not revert the requested changes. Finish after applying both changes.

preexisting_edits.append: LOCAL OWNER NOTE: preserve this uncommitted line.
